description: Work toward a sound goal in rounds, as an engineer would: Kumi listens, finds the biggest gap, you make one change, and Kumi keeps it only if the evidence says so. Start a run with goal: what to reach (loudness in LUFS, a true_peak ceiling in dBTP), a reference (an audio file or clip whose tonal balance, dynamics and low end become targets, each with its range), focus (a track that must cut through: masking is measured against it) and explicit targets. Kumi hears the mix (or track) quietly once and answers with the checklist: each item's value, what it wants and how many just-noticeable steps it's off, the problems it found placed in time and frequency (harsh hits at 0:42, 5.8–7.2 kHz, +9 dB over the local level; a steady resonance; stereo lows; one bass note louder than the rest; the vocal buried 1–4 kHz), and the next target with the kind of fix it calls for. Make ONE change toward that target with Live's devices, then call judge again with change saying what you did. Kumi hears the same bars again, compares every item at equal loudness, keeps the change only if its target improved and nothing else got audibly worse (it takes the change back itself otherwise: don't undo it yourself), brings loudness back to target, and names the next target. Let the problem pick the tool: a steady imbalance is a static EQ (EQ Eight), one that comes and goes is a dynamic band (Multiband Dynamics) or a de-esser, peaks are a limiter, wide lows are mono below a frequency (Utility's Bass Mono), a buried element is a dip in the others keyed from it. Fix a problem where it starts when you can (the hi-hats' harshness on the hi-hat track, not the master). When a target resists two changes in a row, Kumi moves on to the next and comes back to it later. Keep going until every item is within tolerance or changes stop helping (in a /loop, Kumi decides that and asks you), then call judge with done: true, which hears the whole stretch again and reports before → after.

goal.description: Starts a run (and ends any other)

reference.description: A reference: one measured with the reference tool (its name), an audio file's path (~/…) or an audio clip's clipRef

problems.description: Clear what Kumi's detectors find (true when left out)

focus.description: The track that must cut through the rest (its ref or name)

measure.description: dynamics: peak to loudness (dB); density: peak to short-term loudness (dB); range: loudness range (LU); punch: crest (dB); low_width: side under mid below 120 Hz (dB); rumble: under 30 Hz against 30–120 Hz (dB); brightness: tilt (dB per octave, 0 is pink)

track.description: Judge one track (its ref or name) instead of the mix

from_beat.description: Where the stretch starts in the Arrangement, in beats (the whole song when left out)

beats.description: How long the stretch is, in beats

change.description: What you changed since the last judge call, in one line

done.description: End the run: hear the whole stretch again and report before → after
